name: datasketches
description: Bring Apache DataSketches into DuckDB. Approximate quantiles (TDigest, KLL, Quantiles, REQ), distinct-counts (HLL, CPC, Theta), and frequent-items — all serialized as portable BLOBs you can store, share, and merge across processes.

cta.title: Approximate Analytics at Scale
cta.description: Install the DataSketches extension to run streaming quantile, distinct-count, and frequent-item algorithms inside DuckDB — and persist the sketch state to merge later.

quickStart:
-- Estimate distinct count of a high-cardinality column with HLL
SELECT datasketch_hll_estimate(datasketch_hll(12, user_id)) AS distinct_users
FROM events;

-- Compute approximate p50, p95, p99 with KLL
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT datasketch_kll(200, latency_ms) AS sketch FROM requests
)
SELECT
  datasketch_kll_quantile(sketch, 0.50) AS p50,
  datasketch_kll_quantile(sketch, 0.95) AS p95,
  datasketch_kll_quantile(sketch, 0.99) AS p99
FROM agg;
